status: post-review comparator-set revision; historical design and full results retained in external audit backup

target_region.description: Two reliable histories have parameter theta+s_g*g and one discordant history has theta+s_g*g+s_l*ell. The design fully crosses global and local signs for every (g,ell); the discordant source rotates deterministically by replicate within each cell. Thus g denotes the transport shift of the reliable historical cluster rather than the arithmetic mean of all histories.

target_design.discordant_source_rotation: source = 1 + (replicate_id mod 3); every cell pools this prespecified mixture, with source counts differing by at most one when replications are not divisible by three

analysis.survival: Cox partial likelihood; baseline hazard is used only to generate event times
analysis.equal_weighting: Each target scenario receives equal weight in pooled summaries
analysis.inference: Within each outcome-by-scenario stratum, replicate identifiers are resampled with replacement and the same draw is used for every method. Scenarios and outcomes retain equal weight. One-sided paired normal-approximation p-values use stratified-bootstrap standard errors and are Holm-adjusted within the five-method superiority family and separately within the two-ablation family. Familywise one-sided upper confidence bounds use Bonferroni bootstrap quantiles. Coverage lower bounds are one-sided Wilson bounds with alpha/3.
